post_update_notes: Nothing manual required — a large batch: a full audit of Auth/Catalog/Marketing/CMS/Support/System (89 findings, all fixed) plus a performance pass for the ~100k-product catalog. Several real security fixes are included: session fixation on login (both password and social), a privilege-escalation gap that let a non-super_admin grant themselves super_admin, admin/customer password hashes and remember-me tokens no longer written into the Activity Log, and an XSS gap in the WYSIWYG preview endpoint. Also worth knowing: "Seed Demo Data" in the admin panel could previously wipe your entire database on a normal click (a flag-collision bug) — now fixed, but avoid using it on any install with real data if you haven't updated yet. Product stock now automatically restores itself when an order is cancelled or refunded, instead of staying permanently stuck "out of stock." Everything else (Menu Builder, Translations screen, Page SEO/homepage/header/footer flags, and the new OEM search autocomplete dropdown) is either opt-in or purely additive — no existing behavior changes unless you configure it. Full details in CHANGELOG.md.
